entities.name: Uridine kinase A5VKU8
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (218 aa) to reviewed Limosilactobacillus reuteri uridine kinase A5VKU8; EC 2.7.1.48.
Reference annotation places the enzyme in the cytoplasm and assigns uridine kinase and cytidine kinase activities with ATP binding.

entities.name: UMP salvage
observations: Uridine kinase catalyzes uridine + ATP → UMP + ADP + H+ as the first/only annotated step in UMP biosynthesis from uridine salvage.

entities.name: CTP salvage
observations: Reference annotation places uridine kinase in cytidine salvage leading toward CTP biosynthesis; the kinase reaction is cytidine + ATP → CMP + ADP + H+.
